requirements: LM Studio installed, with its local server running
hardware.notes: Attach-only. LM Studio runs the server inside its own app and manages model loading and runtime settings itself; Black Mirror connects to it, lists its model library and chats through it. Start the server in LM Studio (Developer tab, Start Server) or run: lms server start. Nothing is installed and nothing in LM Studio is ever started, stopped, loaded or unloaded.
